News Application¶

A Django news platform for readers, journalists, editors, and publishers. Publishers register a publication and choose their own editors and journalists. Journalists write articles independently or for a publisher. Editors approve articles for their publications. Independent journalists approve their own finished drafts. Readers subscribe to publishers or journalists and are emailed when a followed article is approved.

The project stores data in MariaDB and exposes both HTML pages and a REST API. Generated HTML for this documentation is in _build/html. Open _build/html/index.html in a browser. You do not need to rebuild the docs to read them.

Roles¶

Role

What they can do

Reader

View approved articles and newsletters, and manage subscriptions.

Journalist

Create and edit their own articles and newsletters.

Editor

Review and approve articles for the publishers they belong to.

Publisher

Own a publication and add or remove its editors and journalists.

Further reading¶

Install and run instructions, including virtualenv and Docker, are in the repository README.md. Do not commit a real .env file. Copy .env.example and fill in your own database password and secret key.
